name: iwork-mcp
description: MCP server for Apple iWork automation — 141 tools for Numbers, Pages, Keynote, and Pixelmator

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages bundle && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.test: bun test test/registration.test.ts test/jxa.test.ts test/handle-jxa.test.ts test/install.test.ts test/pixelmator-metrics.test.ts --coverage
scripts.test:all: bun test test/registration.test.ts test/jxa.test.ts test/handle-jxa.test.ts test/install.test.ts test/pixelmator-metrics.test.ts test/numbers.test.ts test/pages.test.ts test/keynote.test.ts test/teardown.test.ts test/pixelmator.test.ts --timeout=180000 --max-concurrency=1
scripts.test:e2e: bun test test/numbers.test.ts test/pages.test.ts test/keynote.test.ts test/teardown.test.ts test/pixelmator.test.ts --timeout=180000 --max-concurrency=1
